grammar.title: A / An / The
grammar.explanation:
Artikl otdan oldin keladi. Oʻzbek tilida artikl yoʻq (faqat «bir» soʻzi ba’zan «a» ga oʻxshaydi), inglizchada esa ot oldidan deyarli doim a/an/the kerak:

- **a** — undosh tovush bilan boshlanuvchi ot oldidan: a book, a car
- **an** — unli tovush (a, e, i, o, u) bilan boshlanuvchi ot oldidan: an apple, an egg
- **the** — aniq yoki avval aytilgan narsa uchun: the sun, the book (oʻsha kitob)

A/an faqat sanaladigan birlik otlar bilan keladi.

grammar.title: Question Words
grammar.explanation:
Soʻroq soʻzlar savolning boshida keladi:

- **What** — nima
- **Who** — kim
- **Where** — qayer(da)
- **When** — qachon
- **How** — qanday
- **How old** — necha yosh
- **How many** — nechta

Namuna: **What is your name?** — Ismingiz nima?

Oʻzbek tilida soʻroq soʻzi odatda gap oʻrtasida yoki oxirida turadi («Ismingiz NIMA?»), inglizchada esa doim BIRINCHI keladi.

rules.pattern: What = nima, Who = kim, Where = qayer
How old are you? = Necha yoshdasiz?

exercises.explanation: Toʻgʻri tartib: Where + are + you + from.

dialogues.title: Conversation Practice
dialogues.scenario: Siz yangi odam bilan tanishyapsiz. Ism, mamlakat, yosh va til haqida gaplashasiz.

lines.speaker: Person B
lines.text: My name is Ali. What is your name?
lines.translation: Mening ismim Ali. Sizning ismingiz nima?

lines.speaker: Person A
lines.text: My name is Sara. Nice to meet you!

lines.speaker: Person B
lines.text: Nice to meet you too! Where are you from?
lines.translation: Men ham tanishganimdan xursandman! Siz qayerdansiz?

lines.speaker: Person A
lines.text: I am from England. And you?

lines.speaker: Person B
lines.text: I am from Uzbekistan. I am in Tashkent.

lines.speaker: Person B
lines.text: I am twenty years old. And you?

lines.speaker: Person A
lines.text: I am nineteen. I speak English.
lines.translation: Men oʻn toʻqqiz yoshdaman. Men inglizcha gapiraman.

lines.speaker: Person B
lines.text: I speak Uzbek and English. Goodbye!
lines.translation: Men oʻzbekcha va inglizcha gapiraman. Xayr!

comps.title: Personal Information Builder
comps.passage: My name is Rustam. I am from Uzbekistan. I live in Tashkent. I speak Uzbek and English. I am nineteen years old. My friend is from England. He speaks English and Russian.
comps.passageTranslated: Mening ismim Rustam. Men Oʻzbekistondanman. Men Toshkentda yashayman. Men oʻzbekcha va inglizcha gapiraman. Men oʻn toʻqqiz yoshdaman. Mening doʻstim Angliyadan. U inglizcha va ruscha gapiradi.

questions.question: What languages does he speak?
questions.explanation: Matn: I speak Uzbek and English.

comps.title: Listening: About a Person
comps.passage: Hello! My name is Karim. I am from Uzbekistan. I live in Tashkent. I am fifteen years old. I speak Uzbek and English. My father is a teacher and my mother is a doctor.
comps.passageTranslated: Salom! Mening ismim Karim. Men Oʻzbekistondanman. Men Toshkentda yashayman. Men oʻn besh yoshdaman. Men oʻzbekcha va inglizcha gapiraman. Dadam oʻqituvchi, onam shifokor.

questions.question: How old is Karim?
questions.explanation: Matn: I am fifteen years old.

questions.question: How do you ask 'Siz qayerdansiz?'
questions.explanation: Siz qayerdansiz? = Where are you from?.

questions.question: How do you say 'Tugʻilgan kun' in English?
Complete: I ___ from Uzbekistan.
questions.explanation: I bilan doim am. → I am from Uzbekistan.

questions.question: Translate: 'Men oʻn yoshdaman.'
questions.explanation: Yosh: I am ... years old. Oʻn = Ten.

comps.title: Anna from England
comps.passage: Hello! My name is Anna. I am from England. I am in London. I am twenty years old. I speak English and Russian. My friend is Karim. He is from Uzbekistan. He is in Tashkent. He is nineteen years old. He speaks Uzbek and English.
comps.passageTranslated: Salom! Mening ismim Anna. Men Angliyadanman. Men Londondaman. Men yigirma yoshdaman. Men inglizcha va ruscha gapiraman. Doʻstim Karim. U Oʻzbekistondan. U Toshkentda. U oʻn toʻqqiz yoshda. U oʻzbekcha va inglizcha gapiradi.

questions.question: How old is Anna?
questions.explanation: Matn: I am twenty years old.

questions.question: What languages does Anna speak?
questions.explanation: Matn: I speak English and Russian.

questions.question: How old is Karim?
questions.explanation: Matn: He is nineteen years old. Oʻn toʻqqiz = Nineteen.
